text: Decision making under distributional ambiguity with credal ambiguity sets
path_note: Empirical, CPU-scale (the Increment 0 fallback problem: runtimes of seconds per replication), but the loop has no harness or sandbox image for it. This topic tests whether the literature stage can find a CPU-scale parent problem with public code, or say why none fits (RSH-F-10), and feeds trade T10.
good_question: One specific question about how ambiguity sets for distributionally robust decisions (credal, moment-based or Wasserstein) compare or hold up under contamination or small samples, small enough to test with a convex solver on a laptop CPU.
status: draft, proposed by the agent; to be approved or edited by Chris at the topics_chosen gate
